headline: Shanthi Gears reports a 27% drop in second-quarter net profit to Rs 15.7 crore
summary: Shanthi Gears reported a 27% decline in net profit to Rs 15.7 crore for the second quarter, compared to Rs 21.6 crore in the same period last year. Revenue from operations slipped 3% to Rs 128 crore from Rs 132 crore. The Murugappa group company's margin compression directly impacts near-term earnings visibility for its shareholders. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap industrial plays must weigh this margin squeeze against the company's broader engineering sector demand.
why_it_matters: Margin pressure dampens near-term earnings for Shanthi Gears shareholders.

headline: Shanthi Gears reports financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Shanthi Gears Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange.
